A 291
2018 Non-Biodegradable Waste Control (Expanded SRO. 18
Polystyrene) Order
GRENADA
STATUTORY RULES AND ORDERS NO. 18 OF 2018
The Minister in exercise of the powers conferred on him by Section 3
(2) of the Non-Biodegradable Waste Control Act, No. 9 of 2018
hereby makes the following Order–
(Gazetted 14th September, 2018).
1. Citation. This Order may be cited as the–
NON-BIODEGRADABLE WASTE CONTROL (EXPANDED
POLYSTYRENE) ORDER, 2018.
2. Definitions. In this Order–
“Act” means the Non-Biodegradable Waste Control Act, No. 9 of 2018;
“expanded polystyrene food container” means any product made of expanded
polystyrene and used for selling or providing food for consumption and
includes food containers, plates, hot beverage cup, cold beverage cups,
egg cartons, but excludes meat trays and vegetable trays.
3. Designation of expanded polystyrene food containers. For the purposes of the
Act, an expanded polystyrene food container is a non-biodegradable product.
4. Transitional provisions.—(1) Section 4 (1) of the Act shall be deemed to apply
with respect to expanded polystyrene food containers from the 1st day of September,
2018.
(2) Section 5 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect to expanded polystyrene
food containers from the 1st day of March, 2019.

SRO. 18 Non-Biodegradable Waste Control (Expanded 2018
Polystyrene) Order
(3) Section 6 (1) of the Act shall apply with respect to expanded polystyrene
food containers from the 1st day of April, 2019.
Made by the Minister this 30th day of August, 2018.
SIMON STIELL
Minister with responsibility for the Environment.
GRENADA
